fact: The Public Finance Management Strategy 2026-2035, as reported on 2026-10-12, says e-SISTAFE is not yet used comprehensively across all relevant processes and sets a target that all major PFM processes run through it by 2035; no event date is given, so the published date is used.

The Minister of Finance's address on the 2024 State General Account (dated November 2025) describes e-SISTAFE as operating, with its revenue collection module and SESPE linking it to commercial banks and e-money institutions to collect taxes and fees into Treasury accounts.
